title: Atenuación epistémica y cautela diplomática
goal: Master hedging devices, epistemic conditional formulas, and perception passives for nuanced academic and diplomatic analysis.
grammar: fórmulas de atenuación asertiva, condicional de modestia y distanciamiento epistémico

items: Apply the conditional of modesty (cabría inferir, se presumiría) to modulate claims.
Employ perception passives like 'parece desprenderse' in data analysis.
Express methodological caution and respectful disagreement without polemical confrontation.
